content: 'idb' (Jake Archibald) is the standard lightweight (~1.2kB) promise-based wrapper over IndexedDB, the most popular such package on npm; it mirrors the native API with promises instead of IDBRequest events and per-store convenience methods, and is the conventional choice for local-first browser apps needing structured, queryable, offline-capable storage of larger record sets (raw event logs, sessions) versus key-value-only alternatives like idb-keyval/localForage.
